research_rule: Математика не сходится. Пока не сойдется.
hypothesis: A wide supplied boundary can remain compact even when no whole component belongs to one projector language, provided several exact partial messages can be discovered and composed without 2^k enumeration or hidden exponential join/DAG/serialization cost.
development_findings_before_runner_freez: An initial uncommitted signed-equivalence gadget exposed a false shortcut: signed equality/anti-equality is itself affine, so GF2 could accept the whole GF2+signed component.

The shortcut was removed before runner freeze without changing preregistered families or gates: signed-equivalence was encoded as a 2-SAT SCC equivalence gadget with a redundant implied internal connector. The relation remained exact but the GF2 syntactic projector could no longer accept the whole mixed component.
After repair, development self-tests had zero whole-projector hits on all four mixed families and required two or three partial languages.

mechanism.decomposition: Remove supplied boundary variables from the connectivity criterion; clauses are grouped only by shared internal variables. This gives exact modules with disjoint internal variable sets.
mechanism.identity: If internal sets I_j are pairwise disjoint, existential projection distributes across conjunction: exists I_1..I_m AND_j F_j(boundary,I_j) = AND_j exists I_j F_j(boundary,I_j).
mechanism.adaptive_layer: ProofMind/uncertainty/shadow/anti-dispersion ordering only; no same-case promotion and no pruning

result.k14: 28 combined component atoms vs 16384 explicit assignments

scaling_observation.interpretation: No measured exponential migration into join, DAG or serialization on these constructed families. This is not a worst-case theorem.

what_worked: No whole-component projector could solve the mixed formulas.
Two or three partial exact languages were required and replayed.
The supplied wide boundary remained represented by O(k)-sized exact messages on the frozen ladder.
ProofMind reduced discovery ordering cost without becoming authority.
what_remains_open: The exact module factorization relies on disjoint internal variables after removing the boundary.
Arbitrary CNF may entangle language fragments through shared internal variables and destroy this clean distribution identity.
Separator discovery remains outside this gate.
No universal polynomial representation/discovery theorem exists.

next_frontier.name: ENTANGLED_PARTIAL_BOUNDARY_COMPOSITION
next_frontier.finish_him: Share internal variables across GF2/Horn/2SAT fragments so module decomposition cannot separate them. Require exact compact projection by a composition language or prove the candidate mechanism fails under frozen resource accounting.
next_frontier.forbidden_shortcut: Do not restore explicit 2^k boundary enumeration and do not hide the exponential in certificate discovery, DAG width, join or serialization.
